name: ThreadItem
reason: ThreadItem is upstream a oneOf of every item variant, and the SDK only ever needs the item's id and kind -- it decodes {id, type} and ignores the rest, which is what the per-kind event types are for. Modelling the full union would add a large flat struct whose fields are all optional and which nothing reads. This only became visible once the generator could emit a struct for a union at all; before that it degraded to json.RawMessage and was never compared.
